scope: All currently recorded unresolved items for 18 audited families, shared dependencies, completeness work and runtime parity. Not a claim that the IPA has no undiscovered logic. No app implementation changes authorized by this checklist.

status_rules.inputs: required records available or correctly derivable, with known units/source/cadence
status_rules.surrounding_logic: preprocessing, history, settings, state and presentation recovered
status_rules.completion: Static completeness requires first three axes. Missing runtime pairs alone does not make a fully recovered static algorithm partial.

task_counting: One checklist row per existing grouped unresolved item, shared work item or per-family fixture suite. These are grouped tasks, not 104 independent blockers or score families. Cross-cutting dependencies can close several rows.

tasks.task: Recover source priority, device/source metadata use, duplicate rejection and sample versus daily/minute aggregate selection.
Identify which conversions occur locally and which occur before Bevel server DTOs. Compare matching normalized records where server behavior is unavailable in the IPA.

Verify upstream RMSSD/SDNN/log-HRV method selection, HR/RHR units, SpO2 fraction/percent, Celsius/Fahrenheit, durations and unit conversions. Recovered downstream Float32 narrowing does not prove upstream equivalence.
Finish functional-day and baseline window generation, timezone/DST behavior, timestamp ordering and calendar endpoints. Confirm selected dates across daily versus combined aggregation.

Trace actual baseline histories, supplied combined-window span, overrides, calibration, validity gates, upstream outlier/nonfinite rejection and histogram keys/bins/quantiles. Default configuration and population SD are already recovered.
Recover default and overridden calculation settings, profile age/sex/temperature choices, context selections and method transitions. Verify any remotely supplied values.
Finish per-metric null/error/pending/calibrating/stale/provisional gates and caller fallbacks. Preserve unavailable output versus valid zero.
Trace historical replay, late data, profile/settings changes, checkpoints, persisted state and algorithmVersion/cached/legacy branches. Establish whether Bevel revises prior days.
Trace native output to UI: rounding, scale conversions, chart clipping, daily/workout aliases, aggregation and notifications. Do not infer native range from display alone.
Verify actual Air-origin records, field presence, cadence, gaps and retention from an authorized account. Separate Air sensing from scale, meals, CGM, blood tests and other integrations.

Recheck and catalogue known Pulse omissions: sample HRV, sample SpO2, short awakenings and discarded provenance/context. Determine required connector retention or derivations per family, without changing connector code in this audit.
Build each family's dependency graph. Verify that every derived input is generated by the recovered path, with required units/history/state, before treating its inputs as complete.
Resolve both added dylibs' initializer and hook targets/effects. Obtain a pristine matching build for comparison if available; names suggesting entitlement logic do not prove score code is untouched.
Audit remaining heuristic annotations, rewritten symbol labels and indirect/async/ObjC dispatch. Use exact bytes, relative pointers, callers and metadata as provenance rather than scratch filenames.

Finish widget/capture calculator comparison and classify remaining registered vitals, glucose variability/fasting glucose, macro balance, EPOC, pace/power/cadence/swim/running dynamics, cycle prediction, journal regression, cardio focus, strength effective weight/RPE/1RM and health trends. Resolve producers and presentation before adding score families.

Inspect relevant opaque assets/resources and remote configuration/model consumers. No named bundled model/table found is not proof that none influences outputs. Separate current web documentation from build-locked evidence.
